svg.title: Where a new primary health care unit would serve the most people, Recife metropolitan region
svg.desc: A map of the conurbation of Recife with the cells of a grid coloured by the residents, now more than 15 minutes on foot from a primary health care unit, that a new unit in the cell would bring within 15 minutes, and 10 numbered sites chosen by maximal covering. Today 74% of the region's residents are within 15 minutes of a unit; the 10 sites would raise that to 78%.

g.text: Recife metropolitan region, on foot: 74% of 3,730,664 residents live within
15 minutes of one of the 691 primary health care units (CNES, small dots).
Each cell is coloured by the residents now beyond 15 minutes that a unit
there would cover. The numbers are the 10 sites chosen one after the other
by maximal covering: together they would bring 173,902 more residents
Where a new health unit would serve the most people
